files.description: Primary b(10) EHI export documentation. 10-page PDF describing per-patient JSON export with field-level data dictionary for Patient, KinList, Meds, Allergies, and Problems sections. Includes a complete sample JSON export.
ONC Disclosure Statement for SMARTMD Palliative Version 6. Lists all certified criteria including b(10). Notes relied-upon software (EMR Direct). Updated January 25, 2025.

58-page FHIR API documentation for g(10) standardized API. Covers SMART on FHIR OAuth2 authentication, FHIR R4 resource endpoints (Patient, AllergyIntolerance, CarePlan, CareTeam, Condition, etc.), and search operations. This is the g(10) API, separate from the b(10) JSON export.

FHIR R4 Bundle containing Direct messaging Endpoint and Organization resources. Points to a test/certification server (fhirserver.justtest.in). Related to h(1) Direct Project criterion, not the b(10) export.

Full-page screenshot of the SMARTMD compliance page showing all documentation links: ONC section with Disclosure Statement and B(10) Export Documentation, Real World Testing Plans, and FHIR Support section.
